signal: Filevine raised $400M across two rounds at a $3B valuation and is unveiling new AI capabilities at Lex Summit

email.body1:
Danielle, saw Filevine raise $400M at a $3B valuation and line up new AI launches at Lex Summit.

Growth like that puts more strategic enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that's where the biggest deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Danielle, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, the enterprise number jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings strategic enterprise needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Danielle, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other well-funded legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Danielle, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch from a big raise into AI launches is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
